_doc: English display names for the 36 sponsors of the ν.998/1979 άρθρο 42 §3 scheme, keyed by the display name queries_extra._sponsor_group produces (the ranking's merged label). The English form is the company's OWN English trade name where it publishes one (ΔΕΗ → PPC, ΔΕΔΔΗΕ → HEDNO, ΑΔΜΗΕ → IPTO, Εθνική Τράπεζα → National Bank of Greece …), else the legal form rendered (Α.Ε. → S.A., ΕΠΕ → Ltd, Μονοπρόσωπη → Single-Member) over an ELOT transliteration. Presentation only: the acts' verbatim spellings stay on the project pages. First use: the author's sponsored-timeline SVG export of 2026-09-23.
